title: Refined Steel Works
description: This mod simply and effectively adds steel metal.
body:
This mod adds the complete set of steel tools and armor which are crafted by upgrading iron tools at the smithing table with a steel ingot.

 

This mod adds the following content.

Items:

Graphite Lump

Steel Ingot

cast iron

Axe Head

 

tools:

Steel Pickaxe

Steel Axe

Steel Shovel

Steel Hoe

 

Weapons:

Steel Battle Axe

Steel Sword

 

Blocks:

Steel Block

 

 

To get the battle axe, you have to find the axe head in a treasure chest in a bastion.
